t: The Verve Thermal Latex Dipped Gardening Gloves are designed to provide hand protection and reliable grip during everyday manual tasks. Ideal for gardeners, landscapers and ground maintenance workers, these multicoloured protective gloves feature a durable latex coating that improves grip when handling tools and plants. A woven lining made from 79% acrylic and 21% polyester offers comfort, while the breathable back helps keep hands cool during extended wear. With elasticated knitted cuffs to keep out dirt and debris, these gloves protect against abrasions, tears and punctures, making them suitable for clearing brambles or planting.
b: Level 2 Cut Resistance Protects Hands During Tasks
High Tear Resistance Offers Long-Lasting Durability & Strength
Latex Palm Protects against Thorns & Sharp Brambles
